title: GOAT – Frosted
description:
GOAT Frosted #16 comes with a taste of softer minty flavour. GOAT Frosted #16 has with a nicotine level of 16,4mg/g (11,49mg/pouch).

A pouch in a slim format that will sit very discreet under your lip.

CONTENT AND INFORMATION

- Nicotine mg/g: 16,4

- Nicotine mg/pouch: 11,49

- Content: 14g

- Format: Slim

- Portions/Can: 20
